transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I just haven't been myself lately. Um... a friend of mine from choir passed away. It was very sudden. And ever since then, I just... I don't know. 

I get all worked up about phone calls I used to handle easy. I catch myself crying over silly things, like the potluck lists... and I've even started missing church planning things that I never would have missed before. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
How long have you been feeling this way, and does it seem to happen even when nothing specific upsets you?

It's been... about a month, I suppose. Ever since she passed. 

And... I don't really know. I guess it just happens.
Have you noticed feeling sad or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even when there's nothing specific going on?

I... I'm not really sure. I don't think I've lost interest, exactly. I still care about the choir and the church. It's just... a bit much right now, I suppose. 

And the sadness is... well, I think it's mostly just because of what happened. I haven't really noticed it happening for no reason.
Have you noticed feeling sad or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even when you're not thinking about your friend or the events related to her passing?
I don't... I don't really know how to separate it, to be honest. It's just sort of always there in the back of my mind. So... I'm not sure.
Can you recall a time in the past week when you felt sad or unmotivated when you weren’t thinking about your friend or her passing?
No... I can't really think of a time. Like I said, it's... it's hard to separate. I haven't really been analyzing it that closely, to be honest. I just don't know.
When you feel sad or overwhelmed, can you tell if it’s because you're thinking about your friend, or does it sometimes happen even when your mind is on other things?

I really couldn't say. Um... even if I'm trying to focus on a chore or something else, she's still... it's all still just there. So I don't think I can give you a clear answer on that. I just... I feel how I feel, I guess.
Can you remember any moments in the past few days when you were not thinking about your friend’s passing, but still felt sad or found it hard to enjoy things?
I... I really don't have a different answer for you. It's just like I said, it's all mixed together. So, no... I haven't noticed a time like that.
Have you noticed any symptoms like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or feeling guilty, even when you aren’t thinking about your friend’s passing?
I... I really don't know. It's just like I keep saying. I haven't noticed anything like that. My sleep and eating are just... whatever they are right now. I can't separate it all out for you.
Can you think of a time in the past two weeks when you felt down or less interested in things, even before you started thinking about your friend’s passing?
I feel like you keep asking me the exact same thing. Um... no. I can't think of a time like that. It's all just... a blur, really. I don't know how else to explain it to you.
Can you think of a time in the past week when you were not thinking about your friend’s passing, yet still felt sad or found it hard to enjoy things?
I... I don't know why we keep going over this. I just... no. I haven't. It's all the same to me.
